BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to traffic control signal preemption devices;amending RCW 46.63.020; adding a new section to chapter 46.61 RCW;adding a new section to chapter 46.04 RCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.61 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) It is unlawful for any person to own or use a traffic controlsignal preemption device except under the following circumstances: (a) The owner or operator of a law enforcement, fire fighting,emergency medical service, or ambulance vehicle for use in providingemergency service; (b) The owner or operator of a department of transportation, city,or county maintenance vehicle for use in performing traffic controlsignal tests or maintenance; (c) The owner or operator of a public transit vehicle for use inproviding transit service; or (d) An employee or agent of a traffic control signal preemptiondevice manufacturer or retailer in the course of his or her employment p. 1 SHB 2319in providing, selling, manufacturing, or transporting a traffic controlsignal preemption device to an individual or agency described in thissection. (2) It is illegal to sell a traffic control signal preemptiondevice except to those who are approved under subsection (1) of thissection. (3) Violation of subsection (1) or (2) of this section is a grossmisdemeanor.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: "Traffic control signal preemption device" means a device thatinterferes with or alters the operation of a traffic control signal.
